pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment: Heating sludge samples (50 ml) in an oil bath (Daihan Science, Korea) at temperatures ranging from 110 °C to 150 °C for 20 min. The reactors were laminated with Teflon to prevent internal corrosion.

Alkaline pretreatment: Addition of 5 N of Ca(OH)_2, KOH, or NaOH solution to 50 ml of WAS to achieve a final pH ranging from 8 to 13. Continuous mixing for 1 h (Ca(OH)_2, KOH, and NaOH) or 20 min (combined pretreatment).
Ultrasonication: Applying 20 kHz frequency (VCX-750, S&M, USA) with a maximum amplitude of 20% to 50 ml of WAS. Reaction times of 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20 min.

Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC): Forced fluid flow through an orifice plate (27 holes of 1 mm diameter) with an upstream pressure of 0.7 MPa and a downstream pressure of 0.07 MPa, resulting in a fluid velocity of 21.2 m/s and a cavitation number of 2.79. Reaction times of 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20 min.
Combined pretreatment: Combination of alkaline pretreatment (NaOH, KOH, or Ca(OH)_2) with hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) and ultrasonication, with reaction times of 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20 min.
